content: This method of attaching the spool holders is quite tedious and difficult to get lined up. 10 minutes to get one nut on.  This is going to take a long time.

Edit* Don't know why they have you set the bed so low, lifting the bed up a bit and then these steps got super easy...

Manually rotating the screws did the trick. Will have to calibrate later but would have had to do that anyway.
